test_title: PYST 49: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On : 01 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A thief started running at a speed of 15 m/s, after running for 12 sec a policeman started running to catch the thief in the same direction at a speed of 20 m/s. How many metre will the policeman run to catch the thief?
solution:
**Given**

Speed of thief = 15 m/s

Speed of policeman = 20 m/s

Thief's head start time = 12 seconds

**Solution:**

⇒ Distance head start of thief = Speed of thief × Thief's head start time = 15 m/s × 12 sec = 180 m

⇒ Relative speed of policeman = Speed of policeman - Speed of thief = 20 m/s - 15 m/s = 5 m/s

⇒ Time policeman needs to catch thief = Distance head start / Relative speed = 180 m/5 m/s = 36 sec

⇒ Distance policeman will run = Speed of policeman × Time = 20 m/s × 36 sec = 720 m

**Hence, the policeman will run 720 meters to catch the thief.**
